title: Benchmarking Knowledge Boundary for Large Language Models: A Different Perspective on Model Evaluation
findings: On the 'world_religions_test' from the MMLU dataset, the models' performance varied significantly. LLaMA2 (19.88) and Mistral (18.07) achieved the highest scores, indicating a larger knowledge boundary in this domain compared to Vicuna (15.06), GPT-J (4.21), and GPT-2 (3.61).
